source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole-board history (board_source.py)
methodology: A window is a comeback only when the board history shows all four: it is on this week's board, it was absent from the immediately-preceding bundle, an earlier bundle carried a genuinely-passed close date (so it really closed - board absence alone is never read as a closure), and its current listing is forward-looking. We claim only that its last run ended on closed_on and it is back now. No guessed comebacks; a missing current end date is 'ongoing', not invented.

items.title: Frankenstein's Mad Scientist Cocktail Lab
items.blurb: A mad scientist themed cocktail lab listed as an exclusive for Nashville, with dates still to be announced. Worth keeping an eye on if you like your drinks served with a bit of theater.

items.title: The Franklin Theatre Songwriters Series: Elvie Shane hosts Nashville Basement Stage Songwriters with La Vie Quartet
items.blurb: Elvie Shane hosts a round of Nashville Basement Stage songwriters, with La Vie Quartet joining. Songwriter nights are the Nashville tradition in its natural habitat, here for one evening only.

items.title: Spice Heaven Grand Opening Week
items.blurb: A new spot celebrating its opening with a full week of events, open from late morning to evening at the Farmers Market. Worth a look while the opening-week energy lasts.

items.title: Belle Meade Holiday Open House
items.blurb: An evening holiday open house at the historic estate. One Thursday night is listed.

items.title: Mott Cha Market | November 2026
items.blurb: The November edition of a market held at Mott Cha, starting at noon on a Saturday.

items.title: Community Day: Free Veterans Day Event
items.blurb: A free community day honoring military veterans.

items.title: Raviolo Pasta-Making Class and Lunch
items.blurb: You make the pasta, then you eat lunch. A two-hour midday class, which is a reasonable excuse to leave the desk on a Friday.

items.title: Christmas Tours at Two Rivers Mansion
items.blurb: Holiday tours of the mansion on two dates, each with two time slots.

items.title: Do615's 14th Birthday Party
items.blurb: The local events site Do615 throws itself a 14th birthday party. One Wednesday evening.

items.title: Ballet of Lights: Sleeping Beauty
items.blurb: A sparkling staging of Sleeping Beauty, with a single date on the calendar. Rated 4.4, tickets from $46.

items.title: Monroe Harding Herb Sale
items.blurb: A two-hour herb sale in the park over Thursday lunch. Small and quick, so walk over before it packs up.

items.title: Soundcheck at Snitch: Jonas Brothers
items.blurb: A soundcheck session with the Jonas Brothers in a Printers Alley venue, which is a one-evening look at the band before the real show. The text gives no price.

items.title: 2nd Annual Duuuval Bar Crawl Weekend
items.venue: Silverbelly Whiskey Distillery & Alan Jackson Museum
items.blurb: A bar crawl weekend starting at a whiskey distillery that also houses an Alan Jackson museum. USD 60.

items.title: Gather for Good: Nashville Dinner Benefit for Dreams and Wishes of TN
items.blurb: A charity dinner supporting Dreams and Wishes of TN, with a baker's dozen of other dates on the calendar if this one does not fit.

items.title: 100 Cities Project: Nashville Dinner Benefiting The Water Project
items.blurb: A charity dinner where the ticket supports The Water Project. Several additional dates are listed, and sales are flagged as ending soon.

items.title: Grand Ole Opry Celebrates the 60th Annual CMA Awards
items.blurb: A special Opry night tied to the 60th CMA Awards, rather than the regular weekly lineup. Sunday evening only.

items.title: Cheekwood Gardening School: Festive Winter Containers
items.blurb: A gardening class on building festive winter containers, held at the estate grounds. Useful if your porch needs help before the holidays.

items.title: Aquarium Nashville - Mystic Mermaids Under the Sea Breakfast
items.blurb: A mermaid-themed breakfast at the restaurant with the big fish tank, aimed at kids.

items.title: Jo Lopez: 30 Years of Photography
items.blurb: A Franklin photographer lays out three decades of work in one showing. A rare chance to see a full career retrospective by a local artist in a single room.

items.title: Candlelight: Tribute to Dolly Parton
items.blurb: A single-night candlelit tribute to Nashville's patron saint of big hair and bigger songs. Tickets start at $36.

items.title: Give A Crap, Nashville
items.blurb: Kelsi Mayne, Hollye B and Shannon McNally play a benefit night. One show only.
